messages:
alex: Repro: short-lived token rotated mid-stream in staging, client sees socket close (EPIPE).

mira: Repro steps?

alex: curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer shortlived' https://frontdoor.redwood/v1/stream -d @p.json, rotate token while active -> abrupt close.

sam: Two patterns: eager-gate (pause until auth refresh) or delegate (frontdoor issues short lease).

ingrid: Also proposal C: signed checkpoints. Frontdoor emits small signed checkpoints with offset+subject; upstream can return resume-checkpoint trailer on reject.

mira: Tradeoffs: eager-gate adds P99 latency; delegate needs KMS/trust across fleet; checkpoint needs client-sdk and small token storage but limits KMS exposure.

alex: Security: leases/checkpoints must bind to TLS fingerprint and be TTL-limited. No resume for non-idempotent writes.

sam: Config idea per-route: auth_policy=eager|delegate_lease|checkpoint, resume_policy=none|client|server_trailer.

ingrid: Metrics to add: lease_issued, checkpoint_issued, midstream_rejects, resume_success. Rollout: dark-launch headers, monitor, opt-in routes.

sec-bot: Flag: request security micro-review for lease/checkpoint formats.

alex: Action items: ingrid RFC draft (ETA Tue), sam inventory write-heavy routes (ETA Mon), mira test harness for auth-flap (ETA Fri).
